name: mdsrs
description: Markdown-native spaced repetition with deterministic, content-addressed cards.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mdsrs/core build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/store build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/file-store build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/postgres-drizzle build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/fs build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/markdown build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/cli build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/example-sveltekit build
scripts.build:pages: pnpm --filter @mdsrs/core build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/store build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/fs build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/markdown build && BASE_PATH=/mdsrs pnpm --filter @mdsrs/example-sveltekit build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mdsrs/core build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/store build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/file-store build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/fs build && pnpm --filter @mdsrs/markdown build && pnpm -r typecheck
